note: PDR drive band spacing: .200″ (recommend two drive bands in the case neck for concentricity) Tip length: .143″. Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. Form factor= .921. The product page also says: "Running in our 1-8″ twist 6.8 Western with a muzzle velocity of 3315 fps at 4200′ elevation, this Hammer HBC™ holds 1800 fps to 1100 yards. It carries an impact vel of 2590 fps at 500y. It has an impact vel at 300y nearly equal to the muzzle vel of 170gr factory ammunition. This pure copper Hammer HBC™ will take your 6.8 Western to the next level." The product page also says: "AT THIS TIME TIPS ARE CONSUMER INSTALLED" The product page also says: "TIPPING BLOCK INCLUDED WITH EACH ORDER"
